owner_decision: September 9, 2026: named government statistical APIs are used under their own terms with the owner's registered key; robots.txt does not govern these documented API paths. Keys live in .local/api-keys.json. data.bls.gov QCEW open-data files are included as a documented keyless programmatic path, pending owner confirmation. Also September 9, 2026: SEC EDGAR's data.sec.gov/www.sec.gov XBRL and ticker-lookup paths are added as a keyless statistical API under SEC's fair-access policy (declared contact User-Agent, no more than 10 requests/second; this project holds to 4). api.eia.gov/v2/ is added keyed (key name eia); until the owner registers a key at the listed registration URL, scripts/import_eia.py makes no network calls at all.

api.bls.gov.limits: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, 20 years/query with a registered key

api.census.gov.limits: 500 queries/day without a key, unlimited with one

data.bls.gov.limits: Documented keyless open-data files; one request per second, files cached locally by hash
data.bls.gov.note: QCEW Open Data Access is documented by BLS for programmatic retrieval and carries no key; the host robots.txt is written for crawlers. Listed here as a keyless documented API path for the owner to confirm or strike.

data.sec.gov.limits: SEC fair-access policy: a declared User-Agent naming the operator with a contact address, no more than 10 requests/second; this project holds to 4 requests/second and its shared api_access.fetch helper further spaces every request one second apart per host.
data.sec.gov.note: Documented XBRL company-facts JSON API, no key required. Listed here as a keyless statistical API path under SEC's own fair-access policy rather than data.sec.gov's crawler-facing robots.txt.
data.sec.gov.agent_note: SEC refuses agent strings in the Bot/1.0 (+url; email) form (HTTP 403) and accepts a plain operator name plus contact address (checked 2026-09-09).

www.sec.gov.limits: SEC fair-access policy: a declared User-Agent naming the operator with a contact address, no more than 10 requests/second; this project holds to 4 requests/second and its shared api_access.fetch helper further spaces every request one second apart per host.
www.sec.gov.note: The single published ticker-to-CIK lookup file used to make CIK resolution deterministic (research/sec-companies.json); not a crawlable page.
www.sec.gov.agent_note: SEC refuses agent strings in the Bot/1.0 (+url; email) form (HTTP 403) and accepts a plain operator name plus contact address (checked 2026-09-09).

api.eia.gov.limits: EIA API v2 requires a free registered key on every call; EIA publishes no fixed rate ceiling beyond fair use. This project's shared api_access.fetch helper spaces every request one second apart per host.
api.eia.gov.note: scripts/import_eia.py makes no network call at all until .local/api-keys.json has an 'eia' key; it prints the registration URL and exits 0 instead.
